_doc: Served GRADE downgrades a signal correction would remove, held at their prior value until a reviewer countersigns the removal (harness/grade.py::_held). A hold never lowers a downgrade.

holds.reason: the 1-level downgrade rested on PHILO's machine D5 'some concerns', which was a false concern (its registered primary 'Major Adverse Cardiac Events (MACE)' -- death from vascular causes, MI, stroke -- was missed); with the registered outcome found, D5 is identity-only (timing not assessed) and the computed downgrade is 0.
holds.by: Claude Opus 5.5 (lane evid2), external review of the ticagrelor-vs-clopidogrel-acs topic (28 Sep 2026)
